screen.ranking: Ascending 2011-2017 mean daily turnover, then fixed recipe name; no return ranking
screen.rule: Greedily retain each strategy unless its positive daily-net-PnL correlation with an already retained representative reaches threshold. Mark only; users may inspect rather than discard.
screen.scope: Training-only statistics determine the rule; rule designed after prior evaluation results were viewed. All subsequent comparisons remain exploratory.

subsets: All 63 nonempty subsets of the fixed six strategies, equal sleeve capital, same original execution dates and underlying netting. Complete enumeration for an interactive calculator, not a search for a winning factor set.
normalization: Optional fixed scale = validation annual PnL sigma of all-six / validation sigma of chosen subset, estimated only on 2018-2019, applied uniformly to PnL/underlying exposure/turnover. It does not guarantee equal future risk or practical leverage feasibility.
reconstruction: For each flagged strategy, fit intercept plus OLS on retained strategy net PnL using 2011-2017 only. Evaluate squared residual against deviation from training mean; statistical span diagnostic, not an executable hedge or independent alpha test.
risk_snapshots: Last available exchange session per month from 2019 through 2026-10-23, windows63/126. Exact covariance of each selected window, all original daily observations used; snapshot sampling is UI navigation only.
counterfactual: Sigma_eta=(1-eta)*diag(Sigma)+eta*Sigma, eta in [0,1]. Labelled counterfactual. Displayed correlation-edge threshold never alters numeric covariance.

uncertainty.scope: Paired circular daily blocks for the one default screened-vs-all comparison. Approximate exploratory intervals, no p-values or claims of a new untouched validation.

physics: Live ER N128, p=rho/127, nested graphs from fixed seeded edge uniforms; cluster moments conditional on the current graph. Existing phase_summary is 40 graphs per N/rho. Common-mode mapping K=q*(lambda/N)^2*S2 is a stated observation model, not a real-market rho estimator.
offline: One self-contained HTML, embedded derived data, no runtime network or credentials; public hosting not performed.
outputs: Numerical sources, interactive browser tool, readable formula/interpretation guide, screenshots, math/UI checks, portable package. Previous delivered evidence immutable.
